**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **§2 (p0011)** creates an evergreen term running "until terminated by either party pursuant to Paragraph 6" — there is no automatic renewal, no renewal term length, and therefore no non-renewal notice window to compute.
- **§6(a) (p0032)** gives either party, including us, a for-any-or-no-reason exit on 15 days' notice whenever no SOW is outstanding; §6(b) adds a 15-day cure-based termination right. Continuation of work requires mutually agreed Statements of Work, which is effectively the playbook's preferred "renewal only by mutual written agreement" outcome. No walk-away trigger (no >90-day window, no multi-year auto-renewal).
- Noted in the rationale but not flagged here: **§3(b) (p0014)** lets Contractor "change rates with 30 days notice to Company" without a CPI or percentage cap. That is a mid-term pricing point rather than a renewal uplift, and its practical impact is contained because the 30-day rate-change notice is longer than our 15-day at-will termination right. It belongs under the fees/price-increase rule rather than being double-flagged here.
